name: University of Derby

facts.text: The University of Derby's main campus is in Derby (Kedleston Road site) and it also has a campus in Buxton.
facts.sourceTitle: About us - Organisation - University of Derby

facts.text: Derby works with industry partners including Rolls-Royce, Toyota and the NHS.
facts.sourceTitle: About us - Organisation - University of Derby

facts.text: The university holds a TEF Gold award (2023).
facts.sourceTitle: About us - Organisation - University of Derby

facts.text: Derby owns Derby Theatre (a 535-seat main auditorium and 110-seat studio) and an Aquatic Research Facility, and runs an Undergraduate Research Scholarship Scheme.
facts.sourceTitle: About us - Organisation - University of Derby

facts.text: Derby is described by a student ambassador as 'a compact but versatile city' in the Midlands, 'in the heart of the UK', and the university estimates students spend a minimum of £1,015 a month.
facts.sourceTitle: Visas and immigration for students - International applicants - University of Derby

sources.title: CAS issuance - Before you start your course - University of Derby
quotes: Why have you chosen this particular course? Did you consider any other courses?
What is it about Derby that makes you want to study here?
What made you choose the UK over your home country or another English-speaking country?
Do you plan to work in the UK?
If you are funding yourself, or it is a parent/legal guardian, where has this money come from?
sources.notes: Pre-CAS Interview is completed through CAS Shield, the university's online self-service platform (usesCasShield = true). Quote: 'The Pre-CAS Interview that you will complete during the CAS request mirrors this interview and will help you prepare for your final interview with the UKVI during your visa application.' Responses are recorded; 'Once completed, your interview will be reviewed, and you will receive an outcome within a few days.' Links a Vimeo guidance video 'Recording your Credibility Interview via CAS Shield'. No pass/fail or retake rules stated.
